findings.title: Debug entitlement in signed application
findings.description: The signed app claims get-task-allow=true, which enables debugger attachment in development builds. This can be intentional for a test IPA; verify that release builds remove it.
findings.remediation: Build and sign the distributed release without the get-task-allow entitlement.

vulnerabilities.message: Limited IPA static checks: ATS exceptions and signed debug entitlement. No runtime behavior was tested.
limitations: Only selected iOS configuration rules were evaluated; no findings does not establish that the app is secure.
